scripts.build: kujo run build.kujo && kujo run build.kujo -- --deck examples/field-notes && kujo run build.kujo -- --deck examples/arabic
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:starters && node tests/contracts.mjs && npm run prepare:browser && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && node tests/start-smoke.mjs && playwright test
scripts.test:native: npm run prepare:browser && PRESENTATION_TEST_HOST=kujo playwright test decks.spec.js motion.spec.js extended.spec.js --project=firefox --output .build/native-browser-results
scripts.deploy:site: npm run build:site && npx --yes wrangler@4.129.0 deploy
